_help: Auto-fit mouth. Per part: v0,v1 = vertical band in lip-space (0=lower lip, 1=upper lip), scales with the opening each frame; z = depth behind lip (m, more negative=deeper); w = width vs mouth width; color RGB. Globals: width (overall x scale), anchor_up (shift band up/down), gate (jaw-open before teeth show). Tune live: render/teeth_viser.sh
